project_type: Go statically-typed Python subset compiler targeting minivm
build_system: go build/test, no Makefile or Dockerfile
test_framework: go test with testify/require, tests beside production code as *_test.go
verification_instructions: 1. go vet ./... 2. go test ./... 3. Confirm new modules register in defaultRegistry() 4. Confirm compiler integration tests pass with import statements
setup_instructions: go mod tidy if new deps are added (none expected)
environment_constraints: Go 1.26.2 available, all tests pass at baseline, no Docker needed
contribution_requirements: Follow docs/coding-patterns.md strictly. Native modules follow module.Symbol pattern (Check/Emit/RuntimeValue). Each module exports const Name and func New(). Update docs/compatibility.md, docs/roadmap.md, docs/spec/06-builtins.md. Keep checker/lowerer synchronized. Tests use public behavior only.
key_patterns: 1. Native module: package with const Name, func New() *module.NativeModule. 2. Symbol: module.NewSymbol(name, checkFunc, emitFunc, valueFunc). 3. Host functions: interp.NewHostFunction with vmtypes params/returns. 4. Registration: compiler/module.go defaultRegistry(). 5. Result funcs pattern from builtins/result.go. 6. Emit pattern from builtins/emit.go. 7. Tests: package-level TestNew and compiler integration tests. 8. typing module shows annotation-only pattern.
directory_structure: token/ lexer/ ast/ parser/ types/ module/ builtins/ operator/ typing/ hostabi/ compiler/ cmd/minipy/ docs/ - each native module is its own top-level package
